entries.note: Round 1. Independent audit of all 37 keys against en/wire.voice.json + wire.voice.context.json, i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and neighbouring wire.settings.speech / wire.voice_availability. Scripted over all 37 keys: key set equals en; {placeholders} identical to en ({session_id},{reason},{limit_mib},{detail}); no ICU plural/select arms in this namespace; identifiers text_origin/qwen_s2s, WAV/WebM/Ogg/MP4, UUID, MiB, Radient and ElevenLabs preserved; no bidi/zero-width controls, no ASCII quotes, no markdown/digit/symbol in the 6 spoken wire.voice.phrase.* strings; max_spoken_chars.help quotes phrase.truncated exactly. target_sha256 is the file audited (post-fix for fr/ru). Glossary/neighbour consistency: conversation, agent, approvals, provider, key and 'try again in a moment' match the shipped corpus of the locale. Back-translations of the 10 most consequential strings (approval/refusal/limit/provider), all faithful: approval_pending: First answer the question or approval on screen.; phrase.on_screen_first: First answer the approval on screen.; not_enabled: Voice mode isn't turned on for this conversation. First turn it on for this conversation.; rate_limited_minute: The voice provider's per-minute limit has been reached. Try again shortly.; rate_limited_day: The voice provider's daily limit has run out. Try again after it resets.; upload_too_large: That recording is too large. Keep it under {limit_mib} MiB.; provider.help: Who hears you and speaks for you, for hands-free voice and the read-aloud button. Radient is charged to your Radient credit; ElevenLabs uses your own key. Only the provider you choose is used, and if it can't serve a request it states the reason instead of switching to another.; provider.choice.none.description: No provider chosen. Hands-free voice stays off until you choose.; provider.choice.elevenlabs.description: Your own ElevenLabs API key. ElevenLabs charges you directly.; provider_unset: First choose a voice provider: Radient or your own ElevenLabs key. Voice mode only uses the provider you choose..  nits: stt_unavailable 'Hãy nhập tin nhắn thay thế' (alt. 'thay vào đó'); phrase.on_screen_first/approval_pending 'trả lời phê duyệt' is calque-adjacent but mirrors the English and the glossary term. Not verified: the English 'Speak button' is a UI label; the locale renders it descriptively as a read-aloud button and the client's real label was not checked here. No rendered, native-speaker, or RTL rendering claim (ur: strings only; bidi handled by the render layer per the style guide). Same model family as the translator, different session and brief.

entries.note: Independent audit of the review-round delta of wire.voice against en/wire.voice.json + wire.voice.context.json, i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and the already-audited neighbours (store_busy for 'try again in a moment', approval_pending/phrase.on_screen_first, 'command' as used in cli.sessions_help, 'conversation' as in not_enabled/switched). Source, context and target sha256 recomputed from the files on disk and equal the translator receipt. Scripted over all 43 keys: key set equals en; {placeholders} identical ({title} in spoken.approval_needed, none in invalid_message); NFC; no bidi/zero-width/format controls; no ASCII quotes. fr: U+202F before ':' in spoken.approval_needed and invalid_message, apostrophe U+2019; ru: 'чуть позже' as in store_busy; zh-CN: full-width ：，。（） throughout; ur: ۔ stops, no bidi controls; hi: danda, 'थोड़ी देर बाद फिर कोशिश करें' as in store_busy. spoken.* strings are short plain words, spoken.link is one word, spoken.code_omitted keeps the English parenthesis pair (optional per context), terms match the shipped corpus (approval, link, code block, sync, command). Back-translations: session_syncing: This conversation is still syncing. Please try again in a moment. approval_needed: Approval needed: {title}. approval_needed_untitled: Approval needed. code_omitted: (code block skipped) link: link invalid_message: That message has not been sent: too long or looks like a command. Same model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5), different session and brief. Text-level audit only: no rendered, TTS-playback, native-speaker or RTL rendering check performed.
